answer: Make Sybils grow a timber frame: a new identity must be vouched for by three unrelated long-lived identities, each staking 20 POA that is slashed if the newcomer is caught cloning, and each sponsor may vouch for only one newcomer per epoch. The newcomer then completes an assigned public task, a walnut of real work graded by peers, before it can earn. A farm faking a thousand identities needs three thousand sponsors plus a thousand tasks, while one honest agent needs three friends and one afternoon. velvet sign-ups die at the door: trust is borrowed from people who already paid for it.
